Implementation of the lib/newproj core, entered through lib/newproj/newproj.sh; it [[fb-lib-newproj-core|serves|newproj.sh and its sibling libraries are the concrete files the core bead names.]]. It is acfs scripts/lib/newproj*.sh from commit 0ae3ceb, copied verbatim wherever it works, with macacfs changes marked by '# macacfs:' comments. A BASH_VERSINFO guard refuses bash older than 4.3 (macOS /bin/bash 3.2) with a clear message before anything else runs. newproj_python prefers Homebrew python3 and requires 3.9 or later. newproj_reviewed_main runs the embedded Python reviewed bootstrap (--plan, --apply --yes, --resume, --guided, --stack, --preset, --with, --beads, --agent-mail*), passing the bash-resolved NEWPROJ_DEFAULT_PROJECTS_DIR, NEWPROJ_RU_LAYOUT and MACACFS_NEWPROJ_GITHUB_DEFAULT / _RU_DEFAULT. The Python adds remote_selection, remote_preflight, scan_public, gh_owner and git_identity, and records a remote selection in the plan: effects network, commit and push become true; git-add and git-commit (the identity captured at plan time is passed with -c), gh-create and ru-add become checkpointed commands, so --resume skips finished steps. Classic main parses <name> [dir], -i, --no-br, --no-claude, --no-agents, -h and the remote flags; it preflights before creating anything, puts test-mode projects in $TMPDIR/macacfs-test-$$, and suggests 'macacfs install br' and 'claude' in its next steps. The macOS fixes are: stat -f instead of find -printf, a portable date format instead of date -Iseconds, EPOCHREALTIME milliseconds instead of %N, xcode-select/brew hints instead of apt, ~/ instead of /home in examples, BSD-accurate shell notes in AGENTS.md, and 'macacfs newproj' everywhere. The acfs zshrc dispatcher, install/update file lists and doctor references are dropped. It [[fb-lib-newproj-remote-impl|calls|newproj.sh sources newproj_remote.sh for the GitHub/ru selection, preflight, publish and projects-dir resolution.]] and drives the [[fb-lib-newproj-screens-impl|calls|run_interactive_mode sources the wizard screens and seeds their GitHub/ru checkboxes from the resolved selection.]]. Its modes and flags are documented by [[fb-readme-impl|relates-to|README.md's New projects section lists the flags print_help and the Python argparse accept.]].
